text:
maria: kicking off phased holdback rollout for rwdv6-lite-int4. plan = 0.5% -> 5% over 6h, with a holdback queue (queuefence) to capture candidate failures. posting config below, pls eyeball quality/latency.

aj: quick Q — what are the exact automatic fallback thresholds?

maria: auto-fallback/failover rules: absolute hallucination delta > 0.8% OR sim_score drop >= 2.5% OR p99 latency increase >= 120ms. fallback target = rwdv6-fp16 (same weights, no quant). also gating on prefix-mismatch rate > 0.3%.

ben-ml: can we add a kv-warmup check? saw int4 cold-kv noise earlier. propose: require warmup hit-rate >= 75% for the sample slice or hold candidate in queue. if not met, drain back to 0.1% until warmed.

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary job started for rwdv6-lite-int4 by maria — https://deploys/reports/1724681230

eva: quick snapshot from 30m shadow run: short-answer MRR ~= baseline (+0.1%), safety metrics okay, but longdoc recall (1k token sim-based recall) down ~1.9% vs baseline on the longdoc-slice. sample: 1/120 failures with hallucinated citations.

maria: that's concerning for longdocs. will add longdoc-specific throttle: cap long-doc token length requests routed to int4 at 10rps and ramp slower. also extend observation window for longdoc slice to 12h.

shawn: strongly agree on slower ramp for longdocs. also propose adding "holdback_queue_size": 200 and a deferred-eval hook that runs a heavier reranker on sampled longdocs before promoting traffic.

ben-ml: adding suggested config patch (copy-paste):
```json
{
  "phased": {
    "steps": [0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05],
    "step_duration_minutes": 90,
    "longdoc_ramp_rps": 10,
    "holdback_queue_size": 200,
    "kv_warmup_threshold_pct": 75,
    "fallback": {
      "on_hallucination_abs_pct": 0.8,
      "on_sim_drop_pct": 2.5,
      "on_latency_p99_ms": 120,
      "fallback_variant": "rwdv6-fp16"
    }
  },
  "watchlist": ["longdoc>800", "safety_high_risk", "prefix_mismatch"]
}
```

aj: LGTM. small nit: i recommend lowering step_duration to 60m and add a quiet-burn check after each step that compares shadow-vs-live on held samples. if quiet-burn shows >1% drift on any watched metric, pause.

maria: ok i will change step_duration -> 60 and enable quiet-burn. I'll also wire the auto-rollback signal to the rollout pipeline so ops can manually override with reason required.

shawn: who will own the immediate monitoring dashboard? need clear on-rotation person.

maria: eva and ben on rotation for first 12h, aj on-call for rollback decisions.

ben-ml: note: for the int4 path, we should also reduce batching slightly to avoid larger p99 spikes on long docs — try max_batch_tokens=4096 instead of 8192 for the int4 route.

maria: good call. updating config and will re-post. next check-in in ~30m after first 0.5% step metrics come in. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary metrics pipeline subscribed: rwdv6-lite-int4 -> /dash/canaries/1724681230

eva: copying initial metric deltas here when available.

maria: thanks all — if you see any immediate safety or recall regressions, tag with @maria and mark thread with :warning:.
